items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Well, sometime Howard, sometime, uh, Albert Walter, just anyone that we'd call, you know, well, we just, it was amusing to us just to go out with no charges. And we'd just go there and we'd play for them.

ctx.x: And then, uh, you know, you wanna come back down here and eat?

It was kids. But, uh, not like they have, uh, your mother, she had her church, couple of, three or four days, I think it was. And she says, uh, when your mother had her church, she said, you all used to come and play. She said, your brother, Cap, your brother, Sylvester, I can't call the rest of them. Well, sometime Howard, sometime, uh, Albert Walter, just anyone that we'd call, you know, well, we just, it was amusing to us just to go out with no charges. And we'd just go there and we'd play for them. And a lot…
Was this before the service or after the service? In between.
